messages:
emma: Postmortem follow-up: recurring categories = cloud control-plane spikes, model-registry throttles, auth refresh storms. Need owners, short runbooks, and a cutover plan for mitigations. Can we claim?
rajesh: I9ll take cloud control-plane. Short plan: add region-aware failover, client-level rate limiting, and a safety circuit. Deliverables: runbook + test harness. ETA: 7 working days.
lina: I9ll own auth refresh storms. Quick fixes: jittered refresh, local token cache (50ms TTL), and secondary provider wiring. Blocking: need security signoff on KMS preview window.
tom: I9ll handle model-registry. Plan: prefetch hot artifacts, implement read-only fallback that serves last-known-good files, and add throttling backpressure in the client. Canary: 5% staging -> 10% prod.
ops-bot: Created epic INF-9133: "dependency-hardening/mini-sprint". Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-9133. Default due: 2027-03-01.
emma: Thanks. Owners add 1-line tasks to INF-9133 today and include success metrics (P99 spike reduction target + incident rate target). Also please add rollback steps and contact rotation in runbooks.
rajesh: Adding a short fallback config to the epic: fallback priority = [local-cache, registry-readonly, degrade-gracefully]. Retry attempts = 3 with exponential backoff.
lina: Sent vendor SLA request to authvendor@partner.example asking for burst policy, contact escalation, and a test endpoint.
tom: Adding canary plan and cron pre-warm at 02:30 UTC. I'll measure memory/cost delta and tag tradeoffs.
emma: We'll do a 20m sync on Friday to confirm assignees and unblock sec. If you picked up an item, assign yourself in INF-9133 and paste a one-line plan. Keep further discussion in the epic. :thumbsup:
